title: Building storm drains and sewers.
officialText:
The size of the building storm drain, building storm sewer and their horizontal branches
having a slope of one-half unit or less vertical in 12 units horizontal (4-percent slope) shall be based on the maximum projected roof
area in accordance with Table 1106.3. The minimum slope of horizontal branches shall be one-eighth unit vertical in 12 units
horizontal (1-percent slope) unless otherwise approved.
